methods.name: _agents
methods.summary: The agents a chat can be started with, by name.

methods.name: _add_agent
methods.summary: Add an agent. Its token, when it has one, is kept in this machine's keychain.

params.name: name
params.description: What the agent is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: url
params.description: The agent's AG-UI endpoint: an `http` or `https` URL that takes the POST of a run and answers with an event stream.

params.name: token
params.description: A bearer token the endpoint wants, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Blank or absent: none.

errors.message: The name is blank, the URL is not an http or https URL, or the keychain did not take the token.

methods.name: _update_agent
methods.summary: Change an agent's name, endpoint or token.

params.name: name
params.description: What the agent is called. Blank is refused with a message.

params.name: url
params.description: The agent's AG-UI endpoint: an `http` or `https` URL that takes the POST of a run and answers with an event stream.

params.name: token
params.description: A new bearer token. Absent: the token stays as it is.

params.name: forget
params.description: Forget the token the agent has.

errors.message: There is no such agent, the name is blank, the URL is not an http or https URL, or the keychain refused.

methods.name: _remove_agent
methods.summary: Remove an agent and its token. Its chats stay, and can be read.

errors.message: There is no such agent, or it is answering in a chat.

methods.name: _chats
methods.summary: Every chat, the most recently used first.

methods.name: _start
methods.summary: Start a chat with an agent, and answer with it (empty).

methods.name: _open
methods.summary: A chat and everything said and done in it so far.

methods.name: _send
methods.summary: Say something in a chat. Answers at once with the chat as it now stands; what the agent says and does follows as `item` and `piece` events and ends with a `turn` event.

params.name: text
params.description: What to say. Blank is refused with a message.

errors.message: There is no such chat, the message is blank, the agent is still answering or is waiting for an answer, or the agent was removed.

methods.name: _answer
methods.summary: Answer a question the agent stopped at (an interrupt), or decline it. When every open question of the chat has its answer the agent goes on, as after `send`.

params.name: decline
params.description: Decline to answer: the agent is told the question was cancelled.

params.name: payload
params.description: The answer as JSON text, of the shape the question asked for (`response_schema` in the item's data). Absent: no payload.

errors.message: There is no such chat or question, it has its answer already, or the agent is still answering.

methods.name: _act
methods.summary: Tell the agent what the person did on a surface it drew (an A2UI action: a button pressed). The agent goes on, as after `send`.

params.name: item
params.description: The id of the `activity` item the surface is in.

params.name: action
params.description: The A2UI action as JSON text: its `name`, the `surfaceId`, the `sourceComponentId` and its `context`.

errors.message: There is no such chat or surface, or the agent is still answering.

methods.name: _stop
methods.summary: Stop the agent's answer in a chat; what it said so far stays.

methods.name: _remove_chat
methods.summary: Delete a chat and everything in it.

methods.name: _item
methods.summary: An item of a chat is new or changed during a turn: the whole item.

methods.name: _piece
methods.summary: Text is added to an item of a chat while it comes.

methods.name: _state
methods.summary: The state the agent shares with a chat changed.

methods.name: _turn
methods.summary: The agent's turn in a chat is over, however it ended (complete, stopped or failed): read the chat again.

token.description: Whether a bearer token is kept for it. The token itself never leaves the keychain.

title.description: The first thing said in it, shortened; `New chat` until then.

agent.description: The name of the agent it is with.

updated.description: When it was last used, ISO 8601 in UTC.

Item.description: One thing said or done in a chat, in the order it happened.

kind.description: `user`: what the person said. `assistant`: what the agent said. `reasoning`: what it thought. `tool`: a tool it used. `activity`: something it is doing, drawn from `data` (an A2UI surface when `name` is `a2ui-surface`). `step`, `subagent`: a part of its work. `custom`: an event of its own. `interrupt`: a question it stopped at. `error`: a run that failed.

text.description: `user`, `assistant`, `reasoning`, `error`: the text. `tool`: its arguments, JSON text. `interrupt`: the question. `subagent`: what it is for.

name.description: `tool`: the tool. `activity`: the activity type. `step`, `subagent`, `custom`: its name. `error`: the agent's code for it.

data.description: JSON text, or empty. `tool`: `{ result?, error?, ours }` (`ours`: a vos tool this app ran). `activity`: its content. `custom`: its value. `interrupt`: `{ reason?, response_schema?, status }` with status `open`, `resolved` or `cancelled`. `subagent`: `{ error? }`.

done.description: False while it is still coming or still running.

waiting.description: The agent stopped at a question that has no answer yet.

state.description: The state the agent shares with the chat (AG-UI state) as JSON text; empty when it has none.
